description.zh: 办公小工具：启动中控台、发票合并。
description.en: Small office tools: launch console and invoice merge.

description.zh: 在左侧栏加一个「办公魔盒」面板，里面是办公小工具的入口。启动中控台：把本机上的服务、系统或脚本按「名称 + 启动命令 + 工作目录」登记一次，之后点「启动」「重启」「停止」，并可直接查看进程输出；把几个服务编进场景后点「一键启动」，会按步骤顺序依次拉起，也能一键停掉这一组。发票合并：选好几张发票 PDF（可调顺序），生成的每一页会实时预览，点「打印」直接调起系统打印对话框选打印机（双面、长边翻页），也可以「生成打印文件」导出一份每张 A4 两面各两张的 PDF 自己打印；排版可选自动 / 左右 / 上下，纸张可选 A4 纵向或横向，可加中缝裁切线。入口是左侧栏底部的「办公魔盒」图标，主页显示当前版本号，右上角「设置」可以改启动中控台的配置文件位置、发票的默认打开文件夹与默认保存文件夹。书签夹：把常用办公系统的地址、账号和指定浏览器存一处，点一下就用那个浏览器打开，密码保存在宿主凭据库。三个工具都在本机运行：发票文件不会离开这台电脑，服务登记保存在 DSH 主目录下的状态文件里。命令以你自己的身份执行，等同于在终端里手动敲一遍；退出 DSH 后，面板启动的进程不会被它继续管理。
description.en: Adds an Office magic box panel at the foot of the left sidebar with entries for small office tools. Launch console: register each local service, system, or script once with a name, command line, and working directory, then start, restart, stop, and read its output; group several into a scene and Start scene runs them in order, while Stop this group stops what that scene started. Invoice merge: pick several invoice PDFs (reorder as needed) and every generated page is previewed live; Print opens the system print dialog to pick a printer (duplex, flip on long edge), and Generate print file exports one PDF with two invoices per A4 side; layout can be auto, side by side, or stacked, paper can be A4 portrait or landscape, and a cut line can be drawn between the two. The home page shows the current version, and Settings changes the launch console state-file location plus the default invoice folder to open and the default save folder. Bookmarks: keep office system addresses, accounts and the browser each opens in, with passwords in the host credential store. All three tools run on this machine: invoice files never leave it, and service registrations live in a state file under the DSH home directory. Commands run with your own permissions, exactly as if typed in a terminal, and processes started from the panel stop being managed once DSH exits.
